title: hypericum tomentosum subsp. psilophytum
intro: Hypericum tomentosum subsp. psilophytum, commonly known as the "woolly St John's wort", is a plant species belonging to the Hypericaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum tomentosum subsp. psilophytum include wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
